answer: Each ledge is a fake identity. The quill is a cross-cluster uniqueness register: clone k needs a separate quorum of B independent branches over its full k-entry prefix, and the attacker must supply one one-use kernel to each branch for every entry certified. Prefix commitment serializes finality and each kernel is one-use, so splitting cannot help; 1,000 clones cost \(5{,}005{,}000\) kernel for \(B=10\). A quorum of colluding branches breaks it.
